# Return an error if the user tries to list a go source file directly in $BOLERO_ROOT/src.
# Tests golang.org/issue/36587

env BOLERO_ROOT=$WORK/goroot
env BOLERO_PATH=$WORK/gopath

bolero env BOLERO_ROOT
stdout $WORK[/\\]goroot

# switch to BOLERO_ROOT/src
cd $BOLERO_ROOT/src

# In module mode, 'bolero list ./...' should not treat .go files in BOLERO_ROOT/src as an
# importable package, since that directory has no valid import path.
env BOLERO_MODULE=on
bolero list ...
stdout -count=1 '^.+$'
stdout '^fmt$'
! stdout foo

bolero list ./...
stdout -count=1 '^.+$'
stdout '^fmt$'
! stdout foo

bolero list std
stdout -count=1 '^.+$'
stdout '^fmt$'

! bolero list .
stderr '^BOLERO_ROOT/src is not an importable package$'

# In BOLERO_PATH mode, 'bolero list ./...' should synthesize a legacy BOLERO_PATH-mode path —
# not a standard-library or empty path — for the errant package.
env BOLERO_MODULE=off
bolero list ./...
stdout -count=2 '^.+$' # Both 'fmt' and BOLERO_ROOT/src should be listed.
stdout '^fmt$'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout ^_$WORK/goroot/src$
[GOOS:windows] stdout goroot/src$ # On windows the ":" in the volume name is mangled

bolero list ...
! stdout goroot/src

bolero list std
! stdout goroot/src

bolero list .
[!GOOS:windows] stdout ^_$WORK/goroot/src$
[GOOS:windows] stdout goroot/src$

# switch to BOLERO_PATH/src
cd $BOLERO_PATH/src

# BOLERO_MODULE=off,BOLERO_PATH
env BOLERO_MODULE=off
bolero list ./...
[!GOOS:windows] stdout ^_$WORK/gopath/src$
[GOOS:windows] stdout gopath/src$

bolero list all
! stdout gopath/src

-- $WORK/goroot/src/go.mod --
module std

go 1.14
-- $WORK/goroot/src/foo.go --
package foo
-- $WORK/goroot/src/fmt/fmt.go --
package fmt
-- $WORK/goroot/src/cmd/README --
This directory must exist in order for the 'cmd' pattern to have something to
match against.
-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/foo.go --
package foo
